text.adf.mjs: turns plain text into Atlassian Document Format paragraphs, line breaks and bullet lists, and reads a document back as text
text.args.mjs: parses a command's positionals and options against its table and reads the comment text from an option or a file
text.args.mjs gotcha: A byte-identical copy lives in the other two integration skills, pinned by a test, so change all three.
text.args.mjs see-also: each integration skill keeps its own copy because a skill may import only from its own folder
text.cli.mjs: runs one command: checks usage, completes missing credentials from Lantern, calls Jira and prints every line through the redactor with an exit code
text.cli.mjs = skills/lantern-jira/scripts/la: asks Lantern for the account only when no email or token is set
text.cli.mjs < skills/lantern-jira/scripts/cr: site, email and token from the environment
text.commands.mjs: the command table and the Jira actions behind it: get, search, comment, describe, list transitions and move to a named status, plus the offline conventions and template commands
text.conventions.mjs: lists the issue templates, the user's own skills about tickets and the saved templates by name and path only, and saves or prints a project template
text.conventions.mjs gotcha: Never reads a template or skill body beyond the description line, and refuses to replace a saved template without force.
text.conventions.mjs see-also: byte-identical copies in the other two integration skills, pinned by a test
text.commands.mjs gotcha: A transition matches the transition's name or its target status, so ask for the available ones before guessing.
text.credentials.mjs: names the three variables Lantern injects, lists the missing ones, validates the https site URL, derives the secrets to mask and declares what to ask Lantern for
text.http.mjs: sends JSON requests with a timeout and turns a refusal into an error that carries the redacted start of the body
text.http.mjs gotcha: The body is redacted before it is cut, so a token straddling the limit leaves no fragment.
text.http.mjs see-also: byte-identical copies in the other two integration skills, pinned by a test
text.jira-api.mjs: Jira calls with basic auth and English responses, sent through the Atlassian gateway by cloud id first and falling back to the site URL when the gateway answers 401 or the cloud id is unknown
text.jira.mjs: entry that runs the Jira skill's command line
text.lantern-socket.mjs: asks the running Lantern over its local socket for the project's account when the environment has none, keeping the answer in memory
text.lantern-socket.mjs gotcha: The environment always wins: a single required variable set means the socket is never contacted.
text.lantern-socket.mjs see-also: byte-identical copies in the other two integration skills, pinned by a test
text.lantern-socket.mjs = src/main/auth/crede: sends the working directory and provider, reads the variables or the refusal
text.messages.json: every sentence the Jira skill prints
text.messages.mjs: looks up a message by dotted key and fills its placeholders, returning the key when missing
text.redact.mjs: masks known secrets in any form, Authorization header values and credentials inside URLs
